text_block_list.text:
One day, as she was striving toward the 
Tokai Stakes, a reporting crew entered the 
grounds to cover the academy. Though word 
was given to ignore them and carry on as 
usual—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fidget fidget... Could Windy-chan get 
interviewed as a current student too...?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Isn't that the "Biting Umamusume" 
people were talking about before...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
You're right! That whole incident was such 
a shock... Should I go ask if there's any 
other juicy stories? She might tell us 
something hilarious...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: RAAAAWR!!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
What was that about? I guess the rumors 
about her bad temper are true after all... 
Note, note... and done.

Searching "Shinko Windy." The suggested 
searches are "biting," "dirty fighter," 
"meme character," and so on...

Not much has changed from before... Barely 
any information focusing on her actual 
ability comes up in the results.
choice_data_list:
*sigh*... Turning things around is so 
hard...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: What are you sighing like that for...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Windy-chan's already vanity-searched 
herself before, so nothing can faze me 
now!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Sheesh... Nobody understands me at all...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan's supposed to be showing 
everyone how strong she is in her races, 
and yet..."

"I have no choice but to run"... Thinking 
that, I've devoted myself wholeheartedly, 
but I still feel no real sense of 
progress...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Dammit... If that's how it's gonna be...! 
I'll win the next race by an overwhelming 
margin!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Because...! If I don't go that far... then 
it's over...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Won't the image from the 'Biting 
Incident' be impossible to overwrite?"

She's probably right... An "overwhelming 
victory" that people want to talk about 
more than any bizarre incident. As long as 
we have that... we can overwrite it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph—! I'll take on whatever comes...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do my solo training!! Leave 
me alone!

She's already working more than hard 
enough... Pushing herself recklessly 
beyond this wouldn't be wise.
choice_data_list:
(Isn't there any good way to handle 
this...?)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hasn't Windy-san's training volume 
lately been crazy?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Totally. Feels like she's going off the 
rails again, or something... Hope she's 
not pushing herself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit dammit dammit! I can hear you! 
You're so noisy, nodda!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(I'll become it...! So strong that no one 
can ever complain...!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(No way... I'm not gonna let it end like 
this!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Windy-chan has an 'ambition' she will 
never... ever back down from, daaa!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...! Ugaaaaahhh!!!

"...Her running is sloppy. Perhaps due to 
impatience, her gaze keeps wavering, 
constantly distracted by the outside of 
the track and the other girls."

"Her lack of focus stems from her 
overwhelming competitive spirit. That flaw 
isn't something that can be fixed 
overnight. However... a fierce competitive 
spirit can also be a strength."
choice_data_list: (If I just change how I use it...?)

text_block_list.text:
I feel like I read about a great training 
method for times like this in a book once. 
If I recall correctly... it was something 
about focusing on your "field of 
vision"...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wah! A new record for Biko-chan! Yay♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You're getting stronger little by little, 
aren't you... Good girl, good girl.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"No, not yet! I have to get much, much 
stronger."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Back during summer camp... I made up my 
mind. That I won't let it end like this. 
That I'm going to snap this losing 
streak...!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Ugaaaaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's Windy-san. She's so pumped 
up...! Though, maybe a bit too pumped up? 
I wonder if she'll be okay...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: She'll... be fine.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I know. Windy-senpai is wayyy stronger 
than people give her credit for. So 
there's nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I need to focus on 
myself. Let's go for one more rep—!

"Controlling a fierce fighting spirit. A 
lapse in focus caused by paying too much 
mind to others. That had always been the 
challenge."

I frantically searched through the 
materials and finally found it. That 
training method was—

If she gets into the zone, she'll be able 
to run with her eyes set purely on the 
goal...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—What did ya wanna talk about? Windy-chan 
wants to go lift weights, y'know?

Beneath her grumpy demeanor, a sense of 
impatience was apparent. Perhaps she too 
was feeling the limits of reckless 
training...
choice_data_list: I have a strategy I'd like to try.
There's a strategy I want to try.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oho...? And that'll make me stronger? I 
shall deign to hear you out.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "The Switch"? What's that?

"Right now, she tends to lose focus by 
worrying about her rivals and the 
reactions of the crowd."

So…… I explained that we should create a 
mental "switch" to narrow her field of 
vision and focus only on what's ahead.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
??? ...What on earth does that mean, noda? 
Specifically... what are you talking 
about, noda?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nowah!!?

I pulled the blackout curtains from the 
window and wrapped them all around her.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What are you doing, dummyyy?! It's 
pitch black!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: The course?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmmm...
choice_data_list:
Marching in place, then jogging on the 
spot...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
choice_data_list:
Ready? Other than what's ahead, it's pitch 
black all around...!

Got it? Everywhere except straight ahead 
is pitch black...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Everywhere except ahead... is pitch 
black...
choice_data_list:
I couldn't see the other girls or the 
audience...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
choice_data_list: Only the finish line is shining

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: O... Oooohhh————?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Kh!! Phew-haah!!

The moment I let go of the curtain, the 
evening breeze whipped the fabric aside, 
and she was spat right out.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W... What was... what was that just 
now...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...? Pitch black, just look 
forward, keep looking forward...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Let's test it outside.

The grounds were filled with Umamusume 
hard at work training. Among them, Shinko 
Windy was—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Um, uh...! Come on, remember... that image 
from before... Grrrrrrrr!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Windy-san... is doing something weird 
again. What kind of game is she 
playing...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Flash!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *Deep breath in*——......

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph—!!

She... broke into a run with a deadpan 
expression. Single-mindedly, devotedly, 
yet with sheer ferocity. Channeling her 
surging fighting spirit solely forward...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“No way... What was that...? She's like an 
entirely different person compared to 
daytime...!”

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing, nanoda... The scenery to the 
side... whooosh, it just vanished, 
nanoda...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Nngh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This is... awesome!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I call it the 'Darkness Switch'!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Mwahahaha! Splendidly done, my evil 
Chief of Staff!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan... is just, like... totally 
amazing!

This looks promising...! She seems to feel 
a real difference herself. Once she gets 
used to it, it should be even more 
effective.

"Let's go for the win in our next race, 
the Tokai Stakes, with this strategy!"
